description: The Average Lies, a fact-checking tool that tests climate claims from the news against 25 years of NASA Earth data across 360 two-degree study areas. Regional averages often hide growing swings between wet and dry months or opposing trends in neighbouring areas. Our tool tests each claim for trends in both the average and the monthly swings using seasonal linear models in Python, then maps the results and reports the statistical confidence of every verdict in a Vite and d3-geo web interface.
